text: {"question": "How many groups were classified based on circadian rhythm changes across ambulatory blood pressure monitorings in pregnancies with chronic hypertension?", "answer": "Based on the circadian rhythm changes across ambulatory blood pressure monitorings, the pregnancies were classified into four distinct groups.", "evidence": "Based on circadian rhythm changes across ABPMs, four groups were classified: persistent dipper (DD,n = 33),dipper to non-dipper (D-ND,n = 22), persistent non-dipper (ND-ND,n = 33), non-dipper to dipper (ND-D,n = 19)."}
